1.title: Todd Blanche Clears Committee Vote, Paving Way for Attorney General Confirmation
1.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination now advances to the Senate floor, where he is expected to be confirmed, even though several Republicans have not yet committed to supporting him.

2.title: What to Watch in Virginia’s First Primary Since Redistricting Battle
2.summary: Redistricting turmoil started, then ended, the campaigns of several Democratic hopefuls and pushed others into more competitive races than they anticipated.

3.title: What to Watch in the Kansas Primaries: Can Republicans Flip a Governor’s Mansion?
3.summary: Republicans see the marquee race to lead the state as perhaps their best chance this year to win a governorship held by Democrats.

4.title: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
4.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent both announced talks had progressed to allow shipments to resume.

5.title: World's oldest president reshuffles army as his absence stokes unease
5.summary: Cameroon's president has been absent for two months while his team denies rumours about his health.

6.title: More than 150 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
6.summary: The boat was attempting to cross to the UK when its engine caught fire, according to French authorities.
